title: Subagent panes open beside a chat; every pane's tab strip must take its own hover and right-click, never a Chromium page window over it (Leo 2026-11-07: a subagent tab with no close button whose right-click opened the chat's menu). Each pane's strip_under_page (debug.pane_chrome) must be empty. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/subagent-tab-strip-hit.json

steps.title: Start the chat's session (the showcase mock answers)
Open subagent 1's pane as its tray line does (debug open_subagent, unfocused: the chat keeps focus)
After subagent 1: no tab strip lies under a Chromium page window outside its holes (debug.pane_chrome strip_under_page)
steps.optional: records each pane's strip_under_page; a mismatch is the finding, not a broken capture

steps.title: Open subagent 2's pane as its tray line does (debug open_subagent, unfocused: the chat keeps focus)
After both subagents: no tab strip lies under a Chromium page window outside its holes (debug.pane_chrome strip_under_page)
steps.optional: records each pane's strip_under_page; a mismatch is the finding, not a broken capture
